description: This file defines the AWS Backup service client for PHP, including method signatures for operations like creating, deleting, describing backups, and other backup-related functionalities. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method annotations for interaction with the AWS Backup service.

classes.name: BackupClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with AWS Backup service, providing various backup management operations.

methods.name: cancelLegalHold
methods.description: Cancels a legal hold on a backup recovery point.

methods.description: Creates a logically air-gapped backup vault.

methods.description: Deletes lock configuration for a backup vault.
